# ChartPulse

> Live market scanners, AI bias and backtesting for stocks, indices, futures, forex and crypto.

ChartPulse is a multi-market trading research tool covering 970+ instruments across 24 exchanges. It provides rule-based signal scanning, market bias analysis, trend-line detection and backtesting. ChartPulse is an analytics and education tool, not investment advice.

## Key Pages

- [Overview](https://chartpulse.io/): live global market dashboard with movers, bias and heatmap
- [Tier-1 Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanner.html): live CALL and PUT setups at each market's day high and low, ranked by quality
- [Day Drive Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/day-drive/): three checks on every market, from the weekly chart to the 15-minute entry, in plain words
- [Trend Line Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/trend-lines/): trend line breakouts and tests on weekly, daily, 4-hour, 1-hour and 30-minute charts for every market
- [Hybrid Trend Line Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/hybrid-trend-lines/): with-trend setups where the day high meets resistance (PUT) or the day low meets support (CALL), with rejection and failed-break alerts
- [AI Scan](https://chartpulse.io/desk/): bias, forecast cone, trend lines on four timeframes and news tone for any symbol
- [All free scanners](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/): Trendline Hero, 200 EMA, trend lines, Day Drive, news, and six strategy scans (liquidity sweep + FVG, Power of 3, range breakout, EMA alignment, Supertrend + RSI, VWAP + EMA 200)
- [Trendline Hero](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/trendline-hero/): PUT at a resistance trend line that is today's high in a downtrend, CALL at a support line that is today's low in an uptrend; 30m to weekly lines
- [Hero with 200 EMA](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/hero-200-ema/): Trendline Hero setups where the 1-hour 200 EMA sits on the same trend line
- [News Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/news/): markets named in the news of the last 48 hours with headline tone, impact, price move since the news and trend
- [200 EMA Scanner](https://chartpulse.io/scanners/ema-200/): daily entries around the 200 EMA in four stages, plus which of 1D, 4H, 1H, 30m, 15m has price at its 200 EMA now
- [Bias](https://chartpulse.io/bias/): daily trend direction for every tracked instrument
- [Market Movers](https://chartpulse.io/movers/): biggest daily moves across all markets
- [Backtesting](https://chartpulse.io/backtesting/): test a strategy on real market history
- [Market Insights](https://chartpulse.io/insights.html): breadth, volatility and momentum across markets
- [News & Impact](https://chartpulse.io/news.html): market news graded for impact with the price reaction
- [Pricing](https://chartpulse.io/pricing.html): plans Starter, Core and Algo
